result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in File & Path Security: 2 FOUND, 3 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Static review of scoped source, contracts, models and configuration; generated client code excluded. No runtime exploitation tests performed.
CWE-22 and CWE-23 describe the same underlying issue. Impact is loading accessible image files; remote exfiltration was not demonstrated.

values.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
values.description: External input can resolve outside the intended restricted directory.

evidence.explanation: SetCatalogItems concatenates the catalog directory and remotely persisted Picturefilename at line 57 and opens it using Image.FromFile at line 58. CreateCatalogItem and UpdateCatalogItem accept the serialized field without containment validation. Parent-directory segments permit loading decodable images outside Assets/Images/Catalog under client filesystem permissions. Arbitrary non-image disclosure or remote exfiltration was not demonstrated.

values.name: Relative Path Traversal
values.description: Parent-directory segments in external filenames can escape the intended directory.

evidence.explanation: The CWE-22 data flow permits relative traversal through Picturefilename, for example ..\outside-catalog.png. This is the relative-path manifestation of the same vulnerability, not an independent issue.

values.name: Absolute Path Traversal
values.description: Absolute input paths escape restricted directories.

values.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
values.description: Dangerous uploaded files are automatically processed.

values.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
values.description: XML external entities expose unintended resources.
